audit.whatIsWrong: Chart gives Kled Level 3 and First item and calls Level 6 even, while the whys and spikes on the same page say Level 3 is where poke-and-reset starts, Level 6 flips the lane, and first item is 'your peak'.
audit.why: Gwen wins this lane at 52.97% and her stated windows are 6 and first item. The chart read as a losing matchup.
audit.corrected: Levels 3, 6 and First item flipped to Gwen in both layers; levels 1-2 and 2+ items left with Kled.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldowns on the two abilities the whole matchup is built around baiting.
audit.why: Bear Trap on a Rope is 11/10/9/8/7s and Violent Tendencies 13/12/11/10/9s. 'Trade when the trap is down' means an 11-second window at rank 1 — that is the concrete instruction the text was missing.
audit.corrected: Numbers added to the spike, whys, cooldown breakdown and Key Ability Interactions.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer calls his Q 'Beartrap on a Rope' (Riot's name is Bear Trap on a Rope), and nothing anywhere states that his dismounted Q is a different ability.
audit.why: Riot's text: when dismounted, Bear Trap on a Rope is replaced by Pocket Pistol, a ranged blast that knocks Kled back. That is the payoff of knocking him off Skaarl — the yank that drags you out of Hallowed Mist stops existing.
audit.corrected: Name fixed and Pocket Pistol stated where the dismount is discussed.

audit.whatIsWrong: Violent Tendencies is described as generic 'on-hits' with no tell.
audit.why: It is an attack-speed burst of four attacks with the fourth hitting hardest — the wind-up, not the cast, is the cue to drop mist.
audit.corrected: Stated in the cooldown breakdown and the level 1-2 spike.

edits.before: Track Kled's Beartrap on a Rope: His engage hook. Dodge it. When it is down — Snip him in your mist.
edits.after: Track Bear Trap on a Rope (Q, 11s at rank 1): it yanks you out of the mist. When it is down, snip him.

edits.before: - Kled Beartrap on a Rope: matchup-defining — His engage hook. Dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Bear Trap on a Rope (Q): 11/10/9/8/7s — the yank that drags you out of mist; when it is down, commit. - Violent Tendencies (W, 13s): four fast attacks, the fourth hits hardest. - Your R: kill windows only.

edits.before: You pick up a real ability rank but you're still soft with no mist; farm rather than fight unless his Bear Trap is on cooldown.
edits.after: You pick up a real ability rank but are still soft with no mist; farm unless Bear Trap on a Rope is on its 11-second cooldown.

edits.before: You out-trade a Kled who's burned Bear Trap on a Rope — bait the pull, E in behind it and snip him off his mount.
edits.after: You out-trade a Kled who has burned Bear Trap — bait the 11s pull, E in behind it and snip him off Skaarl.

edits.before: Snip Snip! him once he's dismounted — his frail un-mounted form melts to %-max-HP magic and the true-damage center snip
edits.after: Snip Snip! him once he is dismounted — his Q becomes Pocket Pistol, a knockback, so he can no longer yank you in

edits.before: Mounted Kled out-stats you early: his Bear Trap on a Rope pulls you in and his Violent Tendencies on-hits shred you before you have W mist or your E reset online — respect it and just last-hit.
edits.after: Mounted Kled out-stats you early: Bear Trap on a Rope (Q, 11s) pulls you in and Violent Tendencies (W, 13s) shreds you over four fast attacks before you have mist or an E reset — just last-hit.

edits.before: This is where it flips. With Q-W-E online you stop running and start punishing: bait his engage — the Bear Trap pull, a mounted dash, or his Chaaaaaaaarge!!! ult — and drop Hallowed Mist exactly as he commits so his on-hits whiff while you stay untargetable from outside the fog and keep snipping. The dismount is your gold mine: once you snip his courage out and he's knocked off Skaarl into his frail foot form, Snip Snip!'s %-max-HP and true-damage center shreds him while your heal-on-damage tops you back up. At 6, Needlework's slow keeps him in the brawl you now win.
edits.after: This is where it flips. With Q-W-E online you stop running and start punishing: bait his engage — the Bear Trap pull, Jousting (E, 13s), or his Chaaaaaaaarge!!! ult — and drop Hallowed Mist exactly as he commits so his on-hits whiff while you stay untargetable from outside the fog and keep snipping. The dismount is your gold mine: once you snip his courage out and he is knocked off Skaarl his Q becomes Pocket Pistol, a knockback that cannot yank you, and Snip Snip!'s %-max-HP and true-damage center shred his foot form while your heal-on-damage tops you back up. At 6, Needlework's slow keeps him in the brawl you now win.

notes: Jousting's second cast dashes back through the original target, so a Kled who E's onto you keeps a return dash — the text has no room to state it without cutting something better. Skaarl's courage/remount thresholds are not in the kit file and were not asserted.
